verses.text: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!

segments.text: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!

verses.text: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.

segments.text: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.

verses.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.

segments.text: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.

verses.text: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.

segments.text: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.

verses.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

segments.text: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

verses.text: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
